"""Command line behaviour: exit status, stdout purity, raw size budget."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

PROJECT = '/workspace/project'
BASE = ('{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],'
        '"channels":[]}')


def invoke(payload):
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', 'main.py'], input=payload,
                          capture_output=True, cwd=PROJECT)
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout, proc.stderr


failures = 0


def check(name, payload, want_prefix=b'{"error":"input"}'):
    global failures
    code, out, err = invoke(payload)
    ok = code == 0 and out.startswith(want_prefix) and err == b''
    try:
        json.loads(out.decode('utf-8'))
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    if not ok:
        failures += 1
        print('FAIL', name, code, out[:60], err[:200])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


check('empty', b'')
check('brace', b'{')
check('not object', b'[]')
check('trailing', BASE.encode() + b' x')
check('bom', b'\xef\xbb\xbf' + BASE.encode())
check('invalid utf8', BASE.encode()[:-1] + b'\xff}')
check('duplicate seed', b'{"seed":"s","seed":"t"}')
check('valid', BASE.encode(), b'{"cases":[],"channels":[]}')
check('valid whitespace', b'\n\t ' + BASE.encode() + b' \r\n', b'{"cases":[],"channels":[]}')
check('nan', b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":NaN,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}')

big = ('{"seed":"' + 'a' * (8 * 1024 * 1024) + '","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,'
       '"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}').encode()
check('over 8MiB seed field', big)

# exactly 8 MiB through the channel filler
PREFIX = ('{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"aa","frames":[],'
          '"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],"events":[],"channels":'
          '[{"name":"e","parts":[')
SUFFIX = ']}]}'
PIECE = '{"case":null,"data":"'


def build(size):
    parts = []
    body = len(PREFIX) + len(SUFFIX)
    while body + len(PIECE) + 65000 + 4 <= size:
        parts.append(PIECE + 'x' * 65000 + '"')
        body += len(parts[-1]) + 1
    parts.append(PIECE + 'y' * 0 + '"')
    raw = PREFIX + ','.join(parts) + SUFFIX
    delta = size - len(raw)
    parts[-1] = PIECE + 'y' * delta + '"'
    raw = PREFIX + ','.join(parts) + SUFFIX
    assert len(raw) == size, (len(raw), size)
    return raw


code, out, err = invoke(build(8 * 1024 * 1024).encode())
print('exactly 8MiB ->', code, out[:30])
if code or out.startswith(b'{"error"'):
    failures += 1
    print('FAIL exactly 8MiB should be accepted')
code, out, err = invoke(build(8 * 1024 * 1024 + 1).encode())
print('8MiB+1 ->', code, out[:30])
if not out.startswith(b'{"error":"input"}'):
    failures += 1
    print('FAIL 8MiB+1 must be rejected')

deep = ('{"seed":"s","definitions":[[' + '[' * 60000 + ']' * 60000 +
        ',"b\\"x\\""]],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}').encode()
check('deep json', deep)

print('cli: %d failures' % failures)
PYEOF
